pathSubtitle: Practice ordering at cafés, restaurants, and food stalls — from simple requests to handling dietary needs and complaints.

lessons.title: At a Café
lessons.completionSummary: You have completed At a Café successfully

questions.prompt: What does the customer order to drink?
options: Tea
Iced coffee
Hot coffee
questions.feedback: Correct! The customer orders hot coffee.

questions.prompt: How much does it cost?
questions.feedback: Correct! The total cost is $5.50.

questions.prompt: What does "order" mean?
options: a list of food and drinks available
served cold with ice
to ask for food or drink in a café or restaurant
questions.feedback: Correct! "order" means to ask for food or drink in a café or restaurant.

questions.prompt: Which sentence shows the correct use of "menu"?
options: Are you ready to order?
I would like an iced coffee.
Can I see the menu, please?
questions.feedback: Correct! "Can I see the menu, please?" is a good example.

questions.prompt: What does "iced" mean?
options: to ask for food or drink in a café or restaurant
a list of food and drinks available
served cold with ice
questions.feedback: Correct! "iced" means served cold with ice.

lessons.title: At a Restaurant
lessons.completionSummary: You have completed At a Restaurant successfully

questions.prompt: What is the soup of the day?
options: Chicken soup
Tomato and basil
Mushroom
questions.feedback: Correct! The soup of the day is tomato and basil.

questions.prompt: What does the customer order as a main course?
options: Grilled fish
Grilled chicken
Pasta
questions.feedback: Correct! The customer orders grilled chicken as the main course.

questions.prompt: What does "starter" mean?
options: the biggest and most important part of a meal
cooked on a grill using direct heat
the first course of a meal
questions.feedback: Correct! "starter" means the first course of a meal.

questions.prompt: Which sentence shows the correct use of "main course"?
options: I'll have the salad as a starter.
I prefer grilled fish to fried.
For my main course, I'd like the pasta.
questions.feedback: Correct! "For my main course, I'd like the pasta." is a good example.

questions.prompt: What does "grilled" mean?
options: the first course of a meal
the biggest and most important part of a meal
cooked on a grill using direct heat
questions.feedback: Correct! "grilled" means cooked on a grill using direct heat.

lessons.title: Dietary Requirements
lessons.completionSummary: You have completed Dietary Requirements successfully

questions.prompt: Why does the customer ask about the risotto?
options: They don't like rice
They are vegetarian
It is too expensive
questions.feedback: Correct! The customer asks because they are vegetarian.

questions.prompt: What allergy does the customer have?
options: Dairy
Gluten
Nuts
questions.feedback: Correct! The customer is allergic to nuts.

questions.prompt: What does "vegetarian" mean?
options: having a bad reaction to a particular food or substance
a liquid base made by boiling meat or vegetables, used in cooking
a person who does not eat meat; food with no meat
questions.feedback: Correct! "vegetarian" means a person who does not eat meat; food with no meat.

questions.prompt: Which sentence shows the correct use of "allergic"?
options: Is there a vegetarian option on the menu?
The soup is made with chicken stock.
I am allergic to shellfish.
questions.feedback: Correct! "I am allergic to shellfish." is a good example.

questions.prompt: What does "stock" mean?
options: a person who does not eat meat; food with no meat
having a bad reaction to a particular food or substance
a liquid base made by boiling meat or vegetables, used in cooking
questions.feedback: Correct! "stock" means a liquid base made by boiling meat or vegetables, used in cooking.

lessons.title: Sending Food Back
lessons.completionSummary: You have completed Sending Food Back successfully

questions.prompt: How did the customer order their steak?
options: Well-done
Medium
Medium-rare
questions.feedback: Correct! The customer ordered their steak medium-rare.

questions.prompt: What else was missing from the order?
options: Fries
Side salad
Bread
questions.feedback: Correct! The side salad was missing from the order.

questions.prompt: What does "medium-rare" mean?
options: meat that is cooked thoroughly with no pink inside
a small dish served alongside the main meal
a way of cooking meat — pink inside, slightly cooked outside
questions.feedback: Correct! "medium-rare" means a way of cooking meat — pink inside, slightly cooked outside.

questions.prompt: Which sentence shows the correct use of "well-done"?
options: I'd like my steak medium-rare, please.
I ordered a side of fries.
She always orders her steak well-done.
questions.feedback: Correct! "She always orders her steak well-done." is a good example.

questions.prompt: What does "side" mean?
options: a way of cooking meat — pink inside, slightly cooked outside
meat that is cooked thoroughly with no pink inside
a small dish served alongside the main meal
questions.feedback: Correct! "side" means a small dish served alongside the main meal.

lessons.title: A Business Dinner
lessons.completionSummary: You have completed A Business Dinner successfully

questions.prompt: What does the client consider ordering?
options: Sea bass
Lamb
Chicken
questions.feedback: Correct! The client considers ordering lamb.

questions.prompt: Why does the host recommend the sea bass?
options: It is cheaper
It is locally sourced
It is the chef's favourite
questions.feedback: Correct! The host recommends the sea bass because it is locally sourced.

questions.prompt: What does "seasonal menu" mean?
options: feeling drawn to or favouring a particular option
unusually good; outstanding
a menu that changes based on ingredients available in the current season
questions.feedback: Correct! "seasonal menu" means a menu that changes based on ingredients available in the current season.

questions.prompt: Which sentence shows the correct use of "inclined towards"?
options: The seasonal menu features fresh autumn vegetables.
The service was absolutely exceptional.
I'm inclined towards the fish tonight.
questions.feedback: Correct! "I'm inclined towards the fish tonight." is a good example.

questions.prompt: What does "exceptional" mean?
options: a menu that changes based on ingredients available in the current season
feeling drawn to or favouring a particular option
unusually good; outstanding
questions.feedback: Correct! "exceptional" means unusually good; outstanding.
